# 00000004497

**TL2-17 ★** — source: 135_范畴逻辑_拓扑斯.md

**English.** Definition: A weak factorization system is a factorization pair satisfying the lifting property. Conjecture: The size of the smallest factorization generated by a given system is an explicit exponential-type function of the generator set, and the lower bound is attained by the algebra generated by the interval. (minimal size of weak factorization system generation)

**中文。** 定义：弱因子系统指满足提升性质的因子分解对。猜想：由给定系统生成的最小因子分解尺寸为生成元集的指数型显式函数,下界由区间生成的代数达到。（弱因子系统生成最小尺寸）
